paper.title: Deep neural network solution of the electronic Schrödinger equation
paper.authors: Jan Hermann, Zeno Schätzle, Frank Noé

results.system_description: Be atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 2 up and 2 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained PauliNet as printed in Table 1.
results.notes: N_up = 2, N_down = 2: not printed, but the 1S ground term of Be lies only in this sector (up to the mirror N_up <-> N_down). The digits that agree with the exact energy are printed in bold. The LiH and H2 rows of the same table give no geometry and are not recorded.

results.system_description: B atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 3 up and 2 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained PauliNet as printed in Table 1.
results.notes: N_up = 3, N_down = 2: not printed, but the 2P ground term of B lies only in this sector (up to the mirror N_up <-> N_down). The digits that agree with the exact energy are printed in bold. The LiH and H2 rows of the same table give no geometry and are not recorded.
